message:
I remember the time we had a big storm looming over us, and I thought, "What a perfect excuse to make some cocoa and hunker down!" But, as the clouds rolled in, I realized I should probably do a little prep work too. I stumbled upon this great resource from the Red Cross that helped me gather supplies and make a simple plan. It felt like a small win just knowing I was ready to ride out the storm with my family, sipping cocoa and playing cards instead of worrying.

What’s your go-to tip for being prepared when the weather gets wild? ☕
